# Moneta

> Moneta is a free, open-source, and privacy-first personal finance tracking application for Android powered by local AI and NVIDIA NIM.

Moneta automatically parses bank transaction SMS messages on-device, categorizes expenses and income, provides rich financial analytics, and integrates with NVIDIA NIM AI for conversational financial insights without compromising user privacy.

## Core Features
- [Overview & Source Code](https://github.com/RA-L-PH/Moneta): Moneta open source repository, architecture overview, and contributing guidelines.
- [Android Releases & Downloads](https://github.com/RA-L-PH/Moneta/releases/tag/Latest): Pre-built APK releases for ARM64 (recommended), ARMv7a, x86_64, and Universal architectures.
- [SMS Parser Documentation](https://github.com/RA-L-PH/Moneta#sms-parsing): Detailed guide on regex-based instant bank SMS parsing for 50+ Indian banks.
- [AI Intelligence & Privacy](https://github.com/RA-L-PH/Moneta#ai-intelligence): Information on local storage architecture, NVIDIA NIM cloud/local LLM queries, and zero data selling guarantee.
- [LLMs Extended Context](https://moneta-insights.pages.dev/llms-full.txt): Detailed full-length project documentation and context for large language models.
